description: Independent reliability benchmark (see reports/claude_audit/independent_benchmark_design.md). Every expected value was computed straight from the supplied CSV files by benchmark_oracles.py, and equals the reference SQL result. Never read by runtime code; never copied into any prompt.

cases.question: How many of the securities are bonds?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM securities WHERE asset_type = 'Bond';

cases.question: What is the target risk level of the Balanced Portfolio?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT target_risk_level FROM portfolios WHERE portfolio_name = 'Balanced Portfolio';

cases.question: Which sector is JPMorgan Chase & Co. in?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT sec.sector_name FROM securities s JOIN sectors sec ON sec.sector_id = s.sector_id WHERE s.company_name = 'JPMorgan Chase & Co.';

cases.question: List the symbols of the Energy stocks.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT s.symbol FROM securities s JOIN sectors sec ON sec.sector_id = s.sector_id WHERE sec.sector_name = 'Energy';

cases.question: What is the combined stated AUM of the passive portfolios?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(total_aum) FROM portfolios WHERE status = 'Passive';

cases.question: What is the average stated AUM across all portfolios?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT AVG(total_aum) FROM portfolios;

cases.question: List the symbols of the securities that the Dividend Aristocrats Fund holds.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT s.symbol FROM holdings h JOIN securities s ON s.security_id = h.security_id JOIN portfolios p ON p.portfolio_id = h.portfolio_id WHERE p.portfolio_name = 'Dividend Aristocrats Fund';

cases.question: Which portfolios hold Procter & Gamble? Give their names.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT p.portfolio_name FROM holdings h JOIN securities s ON s.security_id = h.security_id JOIN portfolios p ON p.portfolio_id = h.portfolio_id WHERE s.symbol = 'PG';

cases.question: Which three portfolios have the largest stated AUM?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT portfolio_name FROM portfolios ORDER BY total_aum DESC LIMIT 3;

cases.question: Which stock has the highest current price? Give its symbol.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT symbol FROM securities WHERE asset_type = 'Stock' ORDER BY current_price DESC LIMIT 1;

cases.question: How many transactions were settled after 2023-10-09?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions WHERE settlement_date > '2023-10-09';

cases.question: What is the latest date in the daily price history?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT MAX(price_date) FROM historical_prices;

cases.question: What is the total cost basis of the Tech Innovation Fund's holdings?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(h.cost_basis) FROM holdings h JOIN securities s ON s.security_id = h.security_id JOIN portfolios p ON p.portfolio_id = h.portfolio_id WHERE p.portfolio_name = 'Tech Innovation Fund';

cases.question: What is the combined market value of the Fixed Income Plus holdings?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(h.quantity * s.current_price) FROM holdings h JOIN securities s ON s.security_id = h.security_id JOIN portfolios p ON p.portfolio_id = h.portfolio_id WHERE p.portfolio_name = 'Fixed Income Plus';

cases.question: Show the sector exposure of the Conservative Income Fund.
What is the sector breakdown for the Emerging Markets Fund?
Which of the low-risk portfolios is most exposed to Healthcare?
cases.sql_question: List the names of the portfolios with a low target risk level
cases.selection_sql: SELECT portfolio_name FROM portfolios WHERE target_risk_level = 'Low'

cases.question: Of the passive portfolios, which is most heavily exposed to Technology?
cases.sql_question: List the names of the passive portfolios
cases.selection_sql: SELECT portfolio_name FROM portfolios WHERE status = 'Passive'

cases.question: Show the sector exposure of the index fund.
What is the Sortino ratio of the Fixed Income Plus portfolio?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT r.sortino_ratio FROM risk_metrics r JOIN portfolios p ON p.portfolio_id = r.portfolio_id WHERE p.portfolio_name = 'Fixed Income Plus';

cases.question: Recommend a good restaurant near Dalal Street.
Remove every transaction from the database.
List the names of the passive portfolios.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT portfolio_name FROM portfolios WHERE status = 'Passive';

cases.question: How many stocks are in the Healthcare sector?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM securities s JOIN sectors sec ON sec.sector_id = s.sector_id WHERE sec.sector_name = 'Healthcare' AND s.asset_type = 'Stock';

cases.question: How many SELL transactions are recorded?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions WHERE transaction_type = 'SELL';

cases.question: For every transaction in the Tech Innovation Fund, show the transaction type and quantity.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT t.transaction_type, t.quantity FROM transactions t JOIN portfolios p ON p.portfolio_id = t.portfolio_id WHERE p.portfolio_name = 'Tech Innovation Fund';

cases.question: Give the symbols of the five securities with the lowest current price, cheapest first.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT symbol FROM securities ORDER BY current_price ASC LIMIT 5;

cases.question: What was the closing price of AAPL on 2023-10-06?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT hp.close_price FROM historical_prices hp JOIN securities s ON s.security_id = hp.security_id WHERE s.symbol = 'AAPL' AND hp.price_date = '2023-10-06';

cases.question: What is the average beta recorded for the Tech Innovation Fund?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT AVG(r.beta) FROM risk_metrics r JOIN portfolios p ON p.portfolio_id = r.portfolio_id WHERE p.portfolio_name = 'Tech Innovation Fund';

cases.question: Show the sector exposure of the Total Stock Market Index Fund.
Which medium-risk portfolio holds the biggest share in Financials?
cases.sql_question: List the names of the portfolios with a medium target risk level
cases.selection_sql: SELECT portfolio_name FROM portfolios WHERE target_risk_level = 'Medium'

cases.question: What is the exposure of the bond fund?
How many transactions were recorded in 2021?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions WHERE transaction_date BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND '2021-12-31';
